name: seaview
title: Sea View
description: A seaside guest house's bay window on seafront-pink render: every room is a sash pane with a gloss-white board hung on a cord, its nightly price in pillar-box red, and a plate hooked on beneath for its status — plain when free, barred when pending, white on red when taken.

tokens.--font-sign: geometric sign capitals: house name, menu, boards, plates, buttons, labels
tokens.--font-text: old-style serif: headings and all reading text
tokens.--text-s: small text: notes under a pane, facts, hours, footer, tables
tokens.--text-l: standfirst under a page title, third-level headings
tokens.--text-price: the price on a board, sized to its pane
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of small capital labels
tokens.--color-bg: page background: seafront render pink (dusk plum when dark)
tokens.--color-text: text, headings, house name and menu on the render
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text on the render: addresses, dates, hours
tokens.--color-accent: the red bar under the current menu item
tokens.--color-rule: double rules at masthead and footer, table lines, blockquote edge, facts row
tokens.--color-board: white sign boards, open plates, the inquiry box
tokens.--color-board-ink: lettering, inner line and buttons on the boards
tokens.--color-board-muted: secondary lettering on a board: facts, hours, note
tokens.--color-red: pillar-box red: board price, closed plate, bars of a pending plate
tokens.--color-red-ink: lettering and inner line on the closed plate
tokens.--color-frame: painted sash frame, meeting rail, sill, photo frames
tokens.--color-frame-shade: shadow line on frame and sill
tokens.--color-cord: the cord and the plate hooks
tokens.--color-hook: the brass hook on the meeting rail
tokens.--color-focus-halo: halo inside the focus ring, so it shows on any ground
tokens.--shadow-board: drop shadow of boards and plates on the glass
tokens.--radius: corners of boards, inquiry box, buttons, code
tokens.--sash: thickness of the window and photo frames
tokens.--pane-min: narrowest pane before the bay drops a column
tokens.--measure: maximum width of a text column
